verdict.rationale: The project's own README documents a built-in web UI served by `llama serve`, shown chatting with a local Qwen model, so the product itself ships a graphical chat interface for local models. The evidence is a brief caption, not detailed documentation. missing for 10: detailed first-party docs on web UI features (conversation management, settings, multimodal input), independent or hands-on corroboration of the web UI.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can chat with local models using a built-in graphical chat interface

citations.quote: Built-in web UI against `llama serve` running Qwen 3.6
